## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (regression test for bug fixes)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` command table, `docs/usage.md`, config comments) if behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** for user-visible changes
- [ ] Model output is not the authority for permissions, Git state, verification or task state
